evaluative_vs_relational.rationale: Evaluation/judgment and relation/intimacy are distinguishable when cues are present and may co-occur; do not force exclusivity. Soft boundary retained for partner-directed insults (MULTI_LABEL allowed).

gambling_vs_crypto.crypto_exclusions: ordinary finance, generic 'token' without crypto sense
gambling_vs_crypto.crypto_inclusions: crypto-asset / blockchain / DeFi / NFT market evidence
gambling_vs_crypto.gambling_exclusions: metaphorical 'bet', speculative-market talk without wagering, ordinary coin minting, storage 'bit' units
gambling_vs_crypto.internet_register_overlap: mediation co-label only; not a third market domain
gambling_vs_crypto.multi_label: allowed when both wagering and crypto-market evidence present
gambling_vs_crypto.rationale: Problematic overlaps were mostly false gold / metaphor / ordinary-coin senses, not a single merged market family.

options_rejected.DEPRECATE: Acceptable synonym; CONTEXT_ONLY preferred to allow future metadata
options_rejected.MERGE: No single merge target without smuggling context dependence

identity_affiliation.rationale: Dual protocols rarely assign CLEAR_POSITIVE identity from text alone; demonym/geography/language rows are INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT. Identity is not admissible as definitive exclusive Stage-B gold. Retain only as optional contextual metadata outside Stage B, not KEEP_AS_LABEL.
